title: Spectral Queueing
tagline: Compare four scheduling rules using spectral radius as a stability proxy across networked queues.

curves.label: Greedy Shortest-Queue
curves.code: let best=-1,bestLen=Infinity; for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ if(queueLen[i]<bestLen){bestLen=queueLen[i];best=i;}} return best;
curves.name: Greedy Shortest-Queue

curves.label: Max-Weight (Backpressure)
curves.code: let sel=0,score=-Infinity; for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ let s=weight[i]*queueLen[i]; if(s>score){score=s;sel=i;}} return sel;
curves.name: Max-Weight (Backpressure)

curves.label: Randomized Service Mixing
curves.code: let r=Math.random(); let idx=Math.floor(r*n); return Math.min(n-1, Math.max(0, idx));
curves.name: Randomized Service Mixing
